## Goal (1-2 sentences)

## Starter ideas (pick one to file as the first issue)
- [ ] Search across clipboard history (text match)
- [ ] Tags / favorites for saved clips
- [ ] Image OCR to searchable text (Tesseract)
- [ ] Retention-rules UI (e.g. wipe images older than N days)
- [ ] Import history from Windows clipboard / ditto

## Acceptance
- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run build` pass
- [ ] No clipboard content transmitted or stored unencrypted (see SECURITY.md)
